name: Factory: The Industrial Devolution
storyline: In the futuristic year of 2039, all factory production worldwide has been completely automated, but is prone to breakdowns. The populace is so dependent on consumption that these disruptions inevitably provoke riots and chaos. You are an EFAST (Emergency Factory Automation Support Technician) whose job it is to keep the production lines running smoothly while repairs are made, manually sorting component pieces and assembling them into final products.
